entities.name: Abolitionist Movement
entities.label: Movement
entities.summary: A global movement to end chattel slavery and the slave trade, spanning the late 18th to late 19th century. Led by figures including Wilberforce, Douglass, Tubman, and Toussaint Louverture, abolitionists used moral persuasion, political lobbying, economic pressure, and armed resistance to dismantle one of history's most entrenched systems of oppression.
